script.title: Got a data breach letter? 8 steps, in the right order
script.hook: 8 steps after a data breach letter, and the order matters more than you'd think.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: Eight steps after a data breach letter, and the order matters. Here's the list I use.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. Dhruv's screen: the breach checklist page No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: First
segments.narration: First, find out what leaked: email and password, card, bank account, or Social Security number. Each one needs different steps.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. Dhruv's screen: step 1 ticked No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Then
segments.narration: Change the password and anywhere you reused it, and turn on two-step sign-in. Card exposed? Call the bank. Social Security number? Freeze your credit at all three bureaus, and get an IRS IP PIN.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. Dhruv's screen: steps 3 to 6 No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Last
segments.narration: Then the official steps at identity theft dot gov, and one warning: the scam follow-ups. The whole list is free, link in bio.

script.title: 'Your account was in the breach': 1 call to hang up on
script.hook: 1 call comes a few days after breach news, from your 'bank's fraud team'. Hang up.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: One call, a few days after a breach is in the news. This is your bank's fraud team. Your account was in the breach.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. Dhruv on camera holding a phone No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The ask
segments.narration: We need to secure it now. Read me the code we just texted you. That code signs them in as you.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a phone with a six-digit code No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The tell
segments.narration: Your bank won't ask for a code, a password or your PIN, and won't ask you to move money to keep it safe.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a bank with a red X over a code No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Do this
segments.narration: Hang up and call the number on your card. Then do the breach checklist. It's free, link in bio.

script.title: SSN in a breach? 2 free locks to turn on today
script.hook: 2 free locks protect you when your Social Security number shows up in a breach.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: Two free locks, when your Social Security number shows up in a breach letter.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. the small round teal shield mascot with big curious eyes holding two padlocks No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Lock 1
segments.narration: A credit freeze, at Equifax, Experian and TransUnion. It's free, it doesn't hurt your score, and it stops new accounts in your name.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a padlock on a credit report No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Lock 2
segments.narration: An IRS identity protection PIN. Six digits, free, and nobody can e-file a federal return with your number without it.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a padlock on a tax form No text, no logos, no real people.
